'''Cygnus Spaceworks''' was a manufacturer of small craft, such as [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], primarily of a military nature. Approximately half of Cygnus' designs were merely modifications and upgrades to previously existing craft.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a prototype of Cygnus Spaceworks' new luxury personnel [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash-landed on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] during a test run.<ref name="Wreckage">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Search the Wreckage}}</ref>

Shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] lured away the design team that produced the [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class shuttle]]. Cygnus remained closely linked to Sienar after this, producing the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] and several ''Lambda'' derivatives under contract and a number of original designs in cooperation.

After years of producing craft for the Galactic Republic, Cygnus quickly became loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Cygnus Spaceworks remained loyal to the Empire even after the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], although many of the shuttles jointly produced by Cygnus Spaceworks and Sienar Fleet Systems fell into the New Republic's hands.

==Behind the scenes==
The name of Cygnus Spaceworks apparently originates in the [[fanon]] work ''[[Book of Imperial Shuttle Plans: Cygnus Spaceworks]]'', published almost a decade before the name was referenced in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] material (in the [[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Imperial Forces|''Star Wars Technical Journal'']] and the computer game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''TIE Fighter'']]). In ''Imperial Shuttle Plans'', Cygnus Spaceworks was associated with the [[Cygnus Star Empire]] and a Cygnus system.
